notes.title: ⚠️🥋 BIG Update Released for Prologue!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/cf50fd57ca1829d3c090a09dca5daca8a0c098c0.jpg[/img]

Attention Martial Arts Masters! I've worked hard and released a new update.🥋🥋 
Here are the details:

[olist]
[*] 🛠️ Massage Salon Quest: Language issue resolved and quest stabilized.
[*] 👥 Student Interaction: Follow or Stop Following commands interface added when approaching our students.
[*] 🏠 Massage Salon Area: Adjustments made to the massage salon quest area.
[*] 🏙️ Town Visuals: Visual improvements made in the town.
[*] 💰 Item Collection: Collecting items like money or potions from the ground is now easier.
[*] 🏴‍☠️ Thief Behavior: Thieves no longer attempt to rob if the character has no money.
[*] 👘 Uniform and Belts: Uniform and belt color changes for students now appear instantly on them.
[*] 🐞 Quest Bugs: Quest acquisition bugs resolved and stabilized.
[*] 🥋 Combat Mechanics: Opponents can no longer block when hit from behind during a fight.
[*] 😴 Quest Stability: Sleeping Woman and Underwear quests stabilized.
[*] 🤸‍♂️ Opponent Moves: Opponents now require two blocks during backward somersaults and two consecutive combo hits. You can no longer interrupt backward somersaults while they are in mid-air.
[*] 🎮 Gamepad Support: Phase 1 completed, our game now partially supports GamePad controllers.
[*] 🦵 Flying Kick: The Flying Kick technique no longer occupies a combo slot, appearing in a separate area instead.
[*] 📚 Tutorial: A simple tutorial added to show how to add newly learned techniques to the attack slots.
[*] 🦗 Grasshopper Student: Grasshopper student now fights to the death alongside us and does not flee during combat.
[/olist]

[b]🥋 You can Download the Prologue Version from the link:[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3081050/Fight_School_Simulator_Prologue/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3081050/Fight_School_Simulator_Prologue/[/url]

notes.title: Mastering New Techniques in Fight School Simulator
notes.content:
Hello Fighters!
We're thrilled to share some exciting updates about our latest features in Fight School Simulator. As you progress through your journey to become a kung fu master, you'll encounter new challenges and opportunities to enhance your skills. Our latest update introduces a dynamic system where learning new techniques from the grandmaster isn't just about observation and practice; it’s about proving your worth through a series of engaging mini-games.

[h2]Earning Your Techniques[/h2]
In the world of Fight School Simulator, mastery comes with effort and dedication. Our grandmaster believes that every technique must be earned, not just learned. Each time you seek to acquire a new move, the grandmaster will set a task for you. Completing these tasks is essential to gain his approval and learn the coveted technique.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/b521fbd36b2ca870d9fd3c059df4a7cc9ee86022.jpg[/img]

[h2]Interactive Mini-Games[/h2]
We’ve introduced a variety of mini-games to make this learning process interactive and fun. These mini-games are designed to test and enhance different aspects of your training:

[h3]Reflex-Based Mini-Games[/h3]
Precision and Speed: These games require you to stop at the right moment by pressing the correct key. Timing is everything, and your reflexes will be put to the test. Can you hit the mark precisely and prove your agility?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/f06548c7acc8cae222deb6a28f988732378d43b0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Determination-Based Mini-Games[/h3]
Focus and Memory: In these challenges, you'll need to execute the correct sequence of key combinations. Memorize the patterns and execute them flawlessly to show your unwavering determination and focus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/6b8d6e14c22d37230e8cbb6dbb873e51315f907c.png[/img]

[h3]Endurance-Based Mini-Games[/h3]
Stamina and Persistence: Here, your endurance is tested. You'll have to click the mouse button as fast as you can within a set time to fill a progress bar. The more you click, the closer you get to mastering the technique, proving your stamina and persistence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/edf1d38e447eaf6565ec428ed7e7eb8b7b5e4154.jpg[/img]

[h2]A Journey of Growth[/h2]
These mini-games not only make the process of learning new techniques more interactive but also help you grow as a martial artist. Each successful completion of a task brings you one step closer to becoming a true master, honing your reflexes, determination, and endurance along the way.

[h2]Your Feedback Matters[/h2]
As always, we value your feedback. Your insights help us improve the game and deliver an even better experience. Let us know what you think of these new features and how they impact your journey in Fight School Simulator.

Stay tuned for more updates, and keep training hard!

Kind Regards,
Queen Developer

notes.title: A Vibrant Village Experience with a Dynamic Day-to-Night Cycle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/6688f54cfbc24af7f68f6e19106639203fafd8df.jpg[/img]

Discover the dynamic day-to-night cycle in our game’s village, where every NPC has a role. By day, the village bustles with life; water carriers, cart pullers, and local tradespeople fill the streets. The drunkard’s antics and the blacksmith’s clang add to the lively atmosphere. As night falls, the mood shifts. NPCs retreat to their homes, and the village becomes a playground for lurking thieves, adding a layer of strategy and suspense.

[previewyoutube=l_M6Fto6-Kc;full][/previewyoutube]

This shift from day to night isn’t just visual—it’s integral to gameplay, influencing player interactions and decisions. Engage with NPCs by day to complete tasks and explore safely. At night, the risks grow, but so do the opportunities for those daring to venture out. Our game offers a rich, evolving environment where no two days are the same, ensuring a compelling and immersive experience that keeps players engaged over time."

This version maintains the essence of the game's day-to-night cycle, emphasizing how it impacts gameplay and player strategy.

notes.title: Train hard, fight harder! 🥋
notes.content:
[b]Elevate Your Skills in Our Latest Martial Arts Game Update! 🥋[/b]

Dive deep into the world of martial arts with our latest update, packed with high-energy music and intense training sequences. Our dojo now boasts over 20 different training apparatus, each equipped with unique animations that bring your training experience to life. As you navigate through the variety of equipment, you'll notice that frequent use leads to wear and tear. It's up to you to keep your gear in top shape, adding a layer of strategy as you manage repairs to avoid training interruptions.

[previewyoutube=mfVruwdzsJE;full][/previewyoutube]

Continuous Improvement and Upgrades

Training is more dynamic than ever. As your students push their limits using our diverse range of equipment, they not only hone their skills but also physically wear down the apparatus. This realistic touch requires you to step in as the master, ensuring that everything is well-maintained and functional. From striking pads to agility ladders, each piece of equipment is crucial for your fighters' growth and must be kept in prime condition to support their journey towards mastery.

Level Up Your Fighters

The more your students train, the more they advance, gaining levels and increasing their prowess. Every session in the dojo contributes to their overall development, with visible improvements in their abilities and technique. Encourage your students to train consistently, and watch as they transform into formidable martial artists, ready to uphold the honor of your school in any challenge. Join us in this continuously evolving training saga, where persistence and dedication lead to ultimate success.

notes.title: Seppuku OR Forgive
notes.content:
We've just integrated a brand new mechanic that adds a layer of depth and consequence to battles. Now, when students flee in battle and bring dishonor upon our esteemed school, you'll face a crucial decision: forgiveness or enforcement of seppuku.

This addition brings a whole new level of strategy and moral dilemma to the game. Will you choose to show mercy and forgive those who falter in the heat of battle, understanding the pressures they face? Or will you enforce the strict code of honor, ensuring that those who bring shame to our school pay the ultimate price for their actions?

It's a decision that will test your principles and shape the destiny of your school. So, which path will you take? The choice is yours, and the consequences will be profound. Let's uphold the honor of our school together!" 🎮🏯

notes.title: Taking care of our Dojo. Mechanics Preview 1
notes.content:
[b]Taking care of our Dojo. Mechanics Preview 1[/b]

New features are being added to make the dojo management more detailed in Fight School Simulator. We provide a realistic simulation where students frequently train, causing equipment to wear out over time. Now, you'll be able to clean the dojo and maintain training equipment. While students train throughout the day, you can monitor the wear levels of the equipment.

[previewyoutube=c6HDdQPvheE;full][/previewyoutube]

By performing regular maintenance and repairs before they reach the point of failure, you can extend the lifespan of the equipment and keep your dojo in top condition at all times.

Additionally, you can ensure a healthy and hygienic environment by having your apprentice clean the dojo at the end of the day or when necessary.
With these new mechanics, you'll be able to manage your dojo more effectively and reach your goal of becoming the best dojo faster.

notes.title: Four Masters, One Destiny: Unveil the Rival Schools of Martial Arts
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/d7b32398697b8fa0abfd1282a016c1d29a2550ce.png[/img]


Get ready to step into the Martial Arts School Simulator, where the epic rivalry among the Four Great Schools unfolds! From the fierce Crimson Dragon Dojo to the unyielding Iron Fist Clan, each school boasts unmatched mastery in their art. Brace yourself for an adventure where tradition clashes with power, and every fight writes history. Are you prepared to join the battle for supremacy?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/752f2c6a83390919b0a124de6a5703b0fb5f87b3.png[/img]

[b]Crimson Dragon Dojo:[/b]

Established in the early 1950s, the Crimson Dragon Dojo specializes in the powerful and swift techniques of karate. Its students embody the perfect amalgamation of discipline, power, and speed. The dojo's emblem, a red dragon breathing fire, signifies its commitment to courage and strength.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/97397856d92ef0eacf75be87741418bce88c0fe5.png[/img]

[b]Silent Bamboo School:[/b]

The Silent Bamboo School represents fluidity and flexibility in martial arts. Focusing on the disciplines of aikido and judo, it teaches its students how to turn an opponent's strength to their advantage. Its symbol, a bamboo stalk bending in the wind yet unbroken, embodies the school's philosophy of resilience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/910f002a00962d635a812488be39450336c61a6b.png[/img]

[b]Iron Fist Clan:[/b]

Combining the powerful techniques of Muay Thai and boxing, Iron Fist Clan teaches its students powerful striking methods. Founded by a legendary fighter, the symbol of this school (a gray and black iron fist piercing through steel armor) epitomizes the school's emphasis on overwhelming strength and indomitable strength.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934567/9c230b45727ebcdcdb6b78db99059c35d0813061.png[/img]

[b]White Crane Institute:[/b]

Grounded in the traditional Chinese martial arts, the White Crane Institute focuses on balanced stances and graceful movements, incorporating the nuances of Tai Chi and Wing Chun. Its emblem, a white crane soaring gracefully, symbolizes the institute's dedication to achieving strength through harmony and fluid motion
